title: Falcon 9-inspired native launch-vehicle geometry
acceptance_checks: Fairing height and maximum diameter equal 13.1 m and 5.2 m
Six parametric surfaces compile into six SEA regions
Shared parametric rings generate six SEA junctions including the deck T junction
assumption_boundary: Only the overall vehicle and fairing envelope dimensions are sourced from SpaceX public information
Internal stations, thicknesses, and equivalent material properties are conceptual editable assumptions and are not SpaceX design data
The fairing uses a smooth cubic radius-versus-station profile
Cylindrical barrels use isotropic reduced-order shell dynamics with ring and critical frequency transitions
Conical and doubly curved fairing skins remain equivalent-unrolled-plate approximations
Fairing interior volume, area, damping, and panel interfaces are conceptual editable acoustic assumptions

references.use: Public vehicle and fairing envelope dimensions
SEA subsystem and junction power-balance framework
Cylindrical-shell ring frequency, modal density, group speed, and radiation transitions
Finite acoustic-cavity modal density, damping, and panel coupling equations
